purpose: Independent artistic terrain references; Blender renders are authoritative for shared geometry.

images.name: 01_front
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: independent 1024x1024 terrain reference image 01 of a ten-angle set for Blender modeling, not a collage.
Reference image: the supplied screenshot is a layout and architecture reference, not an edit target. Redesign the LAND SURFACE, not the settlement.
Create a polished stylized Chinese xianxia valley environment, front view from SOUTH looking NORTH, camera elevation about 35 degrees, nearly orthographic, entire environment visible with margin. Same established palette: desaturated blue-green roof tiles, warm timber, pale limestone, muted jade vegetation, soft neutral daylight.
Fixed layout for all views: small southern sect rebuilding camp in foreground; open-front wooden dormitory on the WEST/left, rectangular herb garden on the EAST/right, a small hexagonal tiled meditation pavilion farther southeast; one clear north-south stone footpath connects camp to compact existing town in center; town's two-story inn on northwest side, low houses and courtyard on east; behind town a gently climbing stone trail with two flights of steps leads NORTH to a modest sect gate terrace. Three distinctive karst peaks enclose the northern background, highest to the northeast. Preserve a broad unobstructed playable corridor and existing landmark relationships.
Main improvement: replace the vast featureless gray plane with continuous sculpted rolling meadow terrain, shallow natural terraces, grass-earth-stone material transitions, integrated cut-and-fill beneath buildings, weathered low retaining walls beside raised paths, rounded soil shoulders around paving, believable blended rocky mountain foothills with scattered scree and pine/bamboo clusters. Trails must meet ground flush without floating slabs or abrupt box cliffs. Mountain silhouettes organic tapered karst with fine vertical weathering, not stacked melted cylinders. Provide modest terrain relief around flat usable camp/town platforms; no deep canyon across walking routes.
Show a bounded landscape diorama on a simple pale neutral background, enough visible terrain around the settlement to model terrain profiles. Clear readable material boundaries, realistic game-scale buildings, attractive handmade 3D environment concept, not photorealism. No HUD, labels, text, people, extra temples, huge stairs, bridges, rivers, new districts, or layout redesign. ONE full image, no panels.

images.name: 02_right
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create independent Blender modeling reference 02_RIGHT.
Image 1 is the STRICT CAMERA AND LAYOUT TARGET: an EAST side orthographic view looking WEST, showing the settlement's long axis HORIZONTALLY from the low camp at LEFT to the high mountain gate at RIGHT. Keep precisely this camera, silhouette orientation, landmark positions, scale, framing and horizontal ground axis. Do NOT turn it into a front view; do NOT put mountains across the back of a front-facing village.
Image 2 supplies ONLY the desired vegetation, weathered limestone, natural ground, earthy path transitions, handmade stylized rendering quality and blue-green roof palette; IGNORE its camera and composition.
Render the landscape in image 1 with the finished natural terrain and organic karst rock detail quality of image 2: well-blended grassy soil terraces, fine scree, mottled limestone cliffs with ledges and pines, no flat gray plane, no conical smooth towers. Preserve all existing settlement structures and their footprint. Same landscape, no added temples, rivers, bridges, characters or labels. White-gray neutral background, entire landmass and all mountain peaks inside the frame, no cropping. ONE image.

images.name: 03_rear
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE independent multi-angle terrain reference for Blender.
Image 1 is STRICT CAMERA AND LAYOUT target. Match its camera, orientation, major landmark positions, scale and occlusion. Do not rotate back to a front view. Image 2 supplies ONLY art style, natural grass/soil transitions, weathered limestone, teal roof palette and handmade finish, NOT composition.
Render the environment from image1 with the artistic quality of image2. Preserve the central settlement, southern camp, northern gate, five rock masses, and open main walking corridor. Refine meadow into gently rolling land, blended dirt shoulders along paved paths, irregular eroded limestone with narrow ledges and pine clusters, integrated mountain foothills. No new buildings, rivers, bridges, people, text or HUD. The whole terrain footprint must fit comfortably within the image, neutral studio backdrop, clear modeling reference. Do not merely mirror an earlier view.
View 03_rear: NORTH looking SOUTH, mountains in foreground obscuring town, distant camp toward top.
